title.en: Fable 25 — The Wolf in Sheep's Clothing

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A wolf wanted to eat a sheep from the flock.
The shepherd guarded them all day.
The dogs sat around the flock.
The wolf waited and did not find a way.

sentences.ar: יום אחד הוא מצא עור של כבש.
sentences.en: One day he found a sheep’s skin.

sentences.ar: הוא לבש אותו וכיסה את הגוף.
sentences.en: He put it on and covered his body.
In the evening he went in among the flock.
The dogs looked and did not say anything.

sentences.ar: הרועה ספר את הכבשים ולא ראה.
sentences.en: The shepherd counted the sheep and did not see.
The shepherd closed them all in the fence.
The wolf lay inside and waited for night.
He thought: now everything is mine.
He almost fell asleep from great joy.
At night the shepherd came back to the fence.
He wanted meat for tomorrow’s meal.

sentences.ar: הוא בחר את הכבש הגדול ביותר.

sentences.en: He took it and did not look.
Whoever lies falls in his own lie.
